label: Glowing tail (dark rooms)
description: Eat phosphorescent mushrooms to light the alien's tail; the halo shrinks stage by stage until it dies out

parameters.label: Glow time per mushroom (seconds)
parameters.help: How long the tail glows after eating one mushroom. The time is split evenly across 3 decay stages: the halo shrinks a step at each one and dies out at the end.

parameters.label: Tail already glowing at start
parameters.help: If false the player starts in the dark and has to reach the first mushroom guided by its own glow.

parameters.label: Eat sound (PSG)
parameters.help: Fire-and-forget PSG blip when a mushroom is eaten.
